example.name: buffer
example.receiver_hint: object : Source by buffer { override fun read(sink: Buffer, byteCount: Long): Long { // Read one byte into a new buffer, then clone it so that the segment is shared. // Shared segments cannot be compacted so we'll get a long chain of short segments. val box = Buffer() val result = buffer.read(box, minOf(byteCount, 1L)) if (result > 0L) sink.write(box.copy(), result) return result } }
